Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 2026

Information We Collect

When you submit our inquiry form, we collect the following information:

  • Your name and work email address
  • Company name, size, and industry
  • Current systems used and the data/reporting issues you describe
  • Phone number (if you choose to provide it)
  • Any additional message you include

How We Use Your Information

We use the information you provide solely to:

  • Understand your business context and data challenges
  • Respond to your inquiry with relevant information
  • Determine whether our engagement is a good fit for your needs

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes. We do not send automated sales sequences or add you to marketing email lists.

Form Hosting

Our inquiry form is processed by Netlify, our hosting provider. Form submissions are stored securely in Netlify's infrastructure and are accessible only to authorized members of our team. For more information, see Netlify's privacy policy.

Cookies & Tracking

This website does not use cookies, analytics trackers, or third-party scripts that collect personal information.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us.

Contact

For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us at hello@veyloradvisory.com.

We build trusted data foundations so reporting gets faster, numbers get cleaner, and internal AI can work on the truth.
